source_notes: Rosters from ESPN site API: https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/football/nfl/teams/{id}/roster. Starter/depth roles from ESPN depth charts: .../teams/{id}/depthcharts (rank/order 1 = starter; other depth-chart slots = depth; practice squad = depth; unlisted active when depth chart present = depth; otherwise unknown). Includes ESPN athlete groups: offense, defense, specialTeam, injuredReserveOrOut, practiceSquad when returned. ESPN kicker abbreviation PK normalized to K. WSH mapped to WAS per abbreviation_policy. ESPN season year(s) in responses: [2026]. Practice squad players included (role=depth). Injured reserve / out players included when listed by ESPN.
gaps: KR/PR: ESPN roster API does not list kick/punt returners as distinct special-teams positions; K/P/LS included when present.
